svg.title: Five recovery stages and the expected outcome at each stage
svg.desc: Detect and authenticate; prepare the correct official image; prove a non-erasing PXE boot; explicitly authorize the SSD and confirm at the target console; observe first boot and restore host networking. Download completion alone is not reset success.

g.text: Follow the app in order. A failed check is a stop condition.
Choose the correct wired link; verify SSH trust; sign in.
Accept OEM terms; verify the full image hash and boot files.
Approve network setup and diagnostic reboot; wait for checks.
Review MAC + disk + serial + image; type ERASE and the serial.
Then reboot into PXE and make the final target-console choice.
Confirm fresh first boot, finish timing, restore host networking.
100% ISO transfer means the image arrived. It does not mean the SSD installation succeeded.
